cognito.name: Cognito Forms
cognito.description: Entries from Cognito forms become requests in Mawred.
Each source is a Cognito form whose entries become requests. Cognito posts every new, changed and deleted entry here.
cognito.newSourceHelp: You'll get three webhook URLs to paste into the form's Post JSON settings.
cognito.noSourcesHelp: Add a source for each Cognito form you want to bring in.
cognito.notLinked: Not linked to a request type yet
cognito.today: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing in the last day} one {{formatted} entry in the last day} other {{formatted} entries in the last day}}
cognito.waiting: {count, plural, one {{formatted} needs a person} other {{formatted} need a person}}
cognito.logHelp: Everything Cognito sent, kept as it arrived. Replay an entry after fixing the mapping.
cognito.pickPersonHelp: Nobody matched this entry. Choose who it is from; their request then starts.
cognito.personHelp: How Mawred finds the employee in each entry.
cognito.name: Name
cognito.formUrl: Public link to the Cognito form
cognito.urlsOnce: These URLs contain a secret. They're shown in full only now.
cognito.urlsHelp: The secret part is hidden. Rotate to get new URLs; the old ones stop working at once.
cognito.copyNow: Copy all three into Cognito now: you won't see them again.
cognito.noHeaders: Cognito can't send custom headers, so the secret is part of the URL. Keep it private.
cognito.rotateHelp: New URLs are issued and the current ones stop working immediately. Update the form in Cognito straight away.
cognito.sampleHelp: Capture a real entry to see Cognito's field names.
cognito.mappingHelp: For each field of the request form, the Cognito field that fills it. Suggestions come from the sample.
cognito.mappingNoForm: Link a request type to map its form fields.
cognito.prefillHelp: Cognito fields to fill in when an employee opens the form from Mawred (shown in the link, so only these).
